title: Designing Agentic AI Workflow Portfolios under Imperfect Selection and Compute Cost
abstract: arXiv:2609.18126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI systems often approach the same task through multiple workflows that differ in reasoning strategy, verification structure, and compute cost. A natural deployment policy is to use the workflow with the highest average performance, but this can be suboptimal because different workflows may succeed on different instances. We study a portfolio-and-selector paradigm in which a firm runs multiple workflow executions and selects the final answer after observing their outputs. Additional executions may uncover correct answers that the best standalone workflow misses, but they consume compute and introduce plausible distractors that complicate final selection. We formulate this as a workflow portfolio problem in which the firm jointly chooses run size and allocation across workflow types. translated_title: 在不完美选择与计算成本约束下设计智能体AI工作流组合
translated_abstract: 智能体AI系统通常通过多种工作流来处理同一任务，这些工作流在推理策略、验证结构和计算成本上各不相同。一种自然的部署策略是使用平均性能最高的工作流，但这可能是次优的，因为不同工作流可能在不同实例上取得成功。我们研究了一种“组合与选择器”范式，其中企业运行多个工作流执行，并在观察其输出后选择最终答案。额外的执行可能会发现最佳单一工作流所遗漏的正确答案，但同时会消耗计算资源，并引入看似合理的干扰项，使最终选择变得复杂。我们将其形式化为一个工作流组合问题，企业需要联合选择运行规模以及在不同工作流类型之间的分配。我们通过几率提升指数来刻画选择器质量，并推导出工作流多样性价值的紧致界限。对于有限的工作流池，我们发展了……
tldr: 该论文将智能体AI工作流的选择问题形式化为组合优化问题，研究企业在不完美选择器和计算成本约束下如何联合优化工作流的运行规模与类型分配，并推导出工作流多样性价值的理论界限。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates agentic AI workflow portfolio design as an optimization problem in which a firm jointly chooses run size and workflow-type allocation under imperfect selection and compute costs, deriving sharp bounds on the value of workflow variety.
